data.body: **[P1] Wait for the root handler before returning PENDING.** When revocation completes `executionExceptionFuture`, `handlerResult` is available even while `handlerFuture` is still running. `drainOperations()` waits only operation workers, so the invocation can return and fire its final plugin event while root user code continues executing. This also makes `revocationMustWaitForRootHandlerBeforeReturning` fail. After safely rejecting late operations, await the root handler’s termination before choosing the invocation outcome.
